subject: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Ortiz <c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com>, Miguel Santos <m.santos@brightwaveanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route

Hi Caroline / Miguel —

Great conversation earlier today — thanks for walking through the integration timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

What we agreed
- Redwood will provide SOC2 summary and a sample invoice for finance to validate payment terms.
- BrightWave will confirm whether procurement prefers a PO (paper) or to use a marketplace vendor/credit card flow.
- If PO, finance will need vendor details, legal contact, and an estimated invoice cadence.

Open items for BrightWave (requested)
1) Which payment path do you expect to take (PO vs card vs marketplace)?
2) Any specific vendor registration or supplier form we should complete?
3) Target date for a PO issuance if you pick that route.

Our actions this week
- I will attach the SOC2 summary and a short procurement playbook that lists common finance asks.
- Ben will prepare a sample invoice + vendor details.
- Lauren will stand by for any SOW edits if legal needs changes.

Attachments: [SOW_v1.pdf (PDF - draft)], [procurement-playbook.pdf (PDF)]

Proposed next touch: I’ll check back next Wed (Apr 21) unless you have a faster timeline. If finance wants to jump on a quick call to review vendor setup, happy to join.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Caroline Ortiz <c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <m.santos@brightwaveanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the recap and the draft SOW. Quick responses from procurement/finance side: 

- Finance is initially leaning toward marketplace invoicing (their preferred path) because it simplifies tax and PO reconciliation for us.
- Procurement, however, wants to see the SOC2 summary and vendor master information before they approve marketplace registration. They also asked: do you show up on the vendor list for any cloud marketplaces already?
- If marketplace isn’t approved, they will default to PO. If that happens, they’ll need a remit-to address, W9 (or international equivalent), and contact for invoicing.

Can you share: SOC2 summary, vendor registration packet, and a sample invoice with vendor details? I can follow up with procurement and give you a short list of any additional supplier forms.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll push to get a decision this week.

Best,
Caroline Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager | BrightWave Analytics
c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com | (617) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Ortiz <c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route

Caroline — attaching a short procurement playbook that often speeds approvals. Highlights inside: vendor packet checklist, typical timeline for PO issuance, and a sample invoice.

Attachment: [procurement-playbook.pdf (PDF)], [sample-invoice-BW-4721.pdf (PDF)]

If finance prefers marketplace, note that we can proactively request a private listing in the BrightWave marketplace (if your platform supports it) — that usually takes 2–3 business days after vendor approval. If they go PO, typical remittance info included in the sample invoice will cover what you need.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement to walk through the packet — say the word.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Ortiz <c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route

Hi Caroline — checking in with a gentle nudge on where this is sitting with procurement/finance. A few options we can move on quickly: 

Options to unblock
- Marketplace: We can start vendor registration immediately if procurement only needs the SOC2 summary and vendor packet (Ben attached). We’ll request a private listing and share the marketplace invoice flow.
- PO (paper): If finance prefers a PO, please share target PO date and any supplier forms — we’ll return W9 + remittance details within 24 hours.
- Card: If your teams want to pilot with a credit card for the initial month, we can enable that too for faster time-to-production.

Short ask: can you tell us by EOD Tue (Apr 26) which path you want so we can provision the right billing and legal artifacts? If procurement wants a short walkthrough of the vendor packet, Ben and I can join a 15–20 minute call.

Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/BW-4721 (pricing + billing paths)

Thanks — we want to keep your integration on track for the May POC.

— Hannah

From: Caroline Ortiz <c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <m.santos@brightwaveanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route

Hannah / team —

Quick update from procurement/finance after our internal sync: 

- Procurement is open to marketplace (their preference), but they need: SOC2 attestation (or summary), the vendor registration packet, and a link to Redwood’s marketplace vendor page to validate vendor taxonomy.
- Legal would like to review the master terms; they asked if Redwood can provide a one-page summary of key commercial terms we typically accept (auto-renew, termination, data residency).
- If marketplace registration gets delayed, finance has instructed us to request a PO. If we end up with a PO, procurement will need a remittance address, W9, and the name/email of the Redwood invoicing contact.

Action for Redwood: can you upload the SOC2 summary and the one-page commercial terms summary to the DocuSign link and/or shared drive? Also, can you provide a short sample invoice (with remit-to) we can pass to finance?

If you can get those items to me by Monday, Apr 26, I’ll push procurement for a decision.

Thanks —
Caroline

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Ortiz <c.ortiz@brightwaveanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gateway to production: procurement pulse & payment route

Hi Caroline — thank you, and appreciate the clarity. Deliverables below — attaching the files to this thread and copying the DocuSign envelope for legal review: 

Deliverables we uploaded (attached)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (2-page executive summary)
- Pay-terms-template.docx (sample invoice / remit-to + vendor details)
- One-page-commercial-terms.pdf (summary of common clauses we accept)

If procurement confirms marketplace: we will request a private listing and share the vendor link (typical turnaround 48–72 hours once vendor packet is approved). If procurement prefers PO: please issue the PO to 

Redwood Inference LLC
Attn: Revenue Operations
100 Market St, Suite 400
San Francisco, CA 94105
EIN: 12-3456789
Vendor contact: invoices@redwood.ai

Next steps we can take now
- Ben will upload the vendor packet to the Drive and notify procurement directly.
- If helpful, Ben and I can be on a 15-minute call with procurement this week to confirm the marketplace tax/timelines.
- Please send PO to invoices@redwood.ai if that’s the chosen path — we’ll prioritize processing.

Links: https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/ABC12345 (legal envelope)

Attachments: [SOC2-summary.pdf], [Pay-terms-template.docx], [One-page-commercial-terms.pdf]

Talk soon — hoping to get this over the line so BrightWave can start the POC in May.

— Hannah
